description: Outside templates, %{ is a modulo operator followed by an object constructor
notes: The spec lists %{ among its operators and delimiters without limiting it to templates, so read as one token it would make x %{} a syntax error. hashicorp/hcl only recognizes %{ inside templates: TemplateControl in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl belongs to the template scanners, so the main scanner reads % and { as separate tokens and this is x modulo an empty object.
